description:
About the Position

Tyndall National Institute in Cork is recruiting a funded PhD researcher on integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) for UAV and non-terrestrial networks — a core 6G research theme. The position stays open until filled, so early applications are advised.

OpportunityPhD in Integrated Sensing and Communication for UAV and Non-Terrestrial Networks – Tyndall National Institute
HostTyndall National Institute
LocationCork, Ireland
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€25,000/year tax-free stipend + university fees covered (Irish national PhD stipend rate)
Application DeadlineOpen - Apply as soon as possible
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Tyndall National Institute in Cork is recruiting a funded PhD researcher on integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) for UAV and non-terrestrial networks — a core 6G research theme. The position stays open until filled, so early applications are advised.

Programme Highlights

  • 6G-era ISAC research embedded in Ireland's leading ICT hardware institute
  • Salaried position with fees covered
  • Access to Tyndall's labs and European telecommunications projects
  • Rolling review until the post is filled

Who Should Apply

Master's or strong bachelor's graduates in electronic engineering, telecommunications, signal processing or applied mathematics with programming skills.

Funding and Costs

Salaried PhD position per Irish research pay scales plus fees, as stated in the job description.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the Tyndall job page with CV, transcripts and references; positions close when filled. Key deadline information: Reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Tyndall National Institute

Tyndall National Institute is University College Cork's deep-tech research institute and Ireland's leading centre for ICT hardware, photonics and wireless systems research.

Official website: https://www.tyndall.ie

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Open - Apply as soon as possible - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
